rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the sheet material used for writing, drawing, or printing.

example.english: This sheet of paper is too thin for painting watercolours.
example.traditional: 呢張紙太薄，唔啱用嚟畫水彩。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 zi2 taai3 bok6 m4 ngaam1 jung6 lei4 waa6 seoi2 coi2

rows.note: Use this for a set of examination questions treated as one exam paper.

example.english: There are several questions on this exam paper that I have no idea how to do.
example.traditional: 呢份卷有幾題我完全唔識做。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gyun2 jau5 gei2 tai4 ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 sik1 zou6

rows.note: Use this for a scientific or academic research paper submitted for publication or review.

example.english: My research paper has finally passed peer review.
example.traditional: 我篇論文終於通過審稿喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 pin1 leon6 man4 zung1 jyu1 tung1 gwo3 sam2 gou2 laa3
